title: Education must remain a common good in the age of AI
discussion_signal: UNESCO presents AI in education as a deliberative-governance and public-accountability question, protecting learner and teacher rights and keeping critical thinking central. The post makes education’s public purpose a counterweight to substitution and automation narratives.
linked_research_question: How do learners, teachers, and institutions retain agency when AI enters teaching, assessment, and education administration?
limits: Institutional statement rather than classroom outcome evidence
No representative learner or teacher sample is presented
Deliberative governance commitments are not implementation proof
